A) Catcoder (Vim) + Korean BBQ bowls
B) Cozy Octopus (VSCode) + smashed avo toast
C) Retro Robot (Emacs) + bánh mì
D) Night Owl (Neovim) + ramen party

li: D) Night Owl + ramen party. Midnight debugging fuel. :ramen:
katie: B) Cozy Octopus + smashed avo toast. Octopi are very calm reviewers. :octopus:
